hooks.command: v=$(sed -n 's/.*"version": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" | head -n 1); echo "td-codecraft ${v:-?}, loaded at the start of this chat."; echo; cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/essentials.md"; s="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/td-codecraft/stack.md"; if [ ! -f "$s" ]; then echo; echo "This project has no .claude/td-codecraft/stack.md yet: suggest /td-codecraft:init."; fi
